Welcome
Welcome to Haymerle
We are a special school committed to supporting children with a diagnosis of autistic spectrum disorders and social communication difficulties alongside additional needs – including significant speech and language difficulties, developmental delay and complex learning needs.
With us, your child is supported and encouraged to develop independence and the life skills they need for the future. Your child will be given many opportunities to enjoy and experience stimulating academic and creative learning opportunities. We welcome visits from parents and carers who would like to find out how we could support your child.
Please feel free to contact the Headteacher, Nathan Taylor, or the School Office should you require any information about the School and what we do.
Contact us on 020 7639 6080, or email reception@haymerle.southwark.sch.uk.

PE and Sports Premium
Important Information
PE and Sports Premium
The PE and Sport Premium is a government-backed funding initiative aimed at helping primary schools across England improve their physical education and sport provisions.
PE & Sports Premium
At Haymerle School, we believe that our pupils should have access to quality physical education sessions. We use our PE and Sport Grant to enable a PE specialist to give booster sessions in PE in order to increase staff confidence and knowledge when delivering the PE curriculum. We encourage our pupils to work together during these sessions. We are always looking to invest in new and exciting sports equipment to enable all our pupils to have equal access to PE and Sport.
Through our PE sessions at Haymerle pupils develop fundamental movement skills, become increasingly competent and confident and access a range of opportunities to extend their agility, balance and coordination, individually and with others.
Pupils are taught to master basic movements including running, jumping, climbing, crawling, directional movement, throwing and catching; and begin to apply these in a range of activities such as adapted gymnastics or athletics.
For more information on the PE and Sport Premium, please click here.

Family App
We are aware that some of our young people find it difficult to tell you about their day at school. At Haymerle School we have an ICT application (app) that you can access from tablets and phones. The app is called the EFL (Evidence for Learning) Family App. Using the app lets you see photos of your child at school with staff comments to keep you up to date. The app has additional features allowing you to comment on your child’s learning and even upload some of your own wow moments or activities the children have enjoyed at the weekend so these can then be shared with the class.
Parents, carers and family members are able to view evidence shared with them through Evidence for Learning Family App as well as share photos and videos from home with school. At Haymerle School we find this a very valuable tool to enable us to share our pupils’ successes both at home and at school.
For more information about the family app as well as the agreement form and how we can set this up for you please see the documents below:

Healthy Living
At Haymerle School we believe that a healthy lifestyle forms an important part of our pupils’ development. We engage the pupils in many physical activities including the use of our Gym, Soft Play area, outdoor spaces and swimming sessions. We also have weekly Yoga sessions for our pupils, on a rotation basis. We are also involved in a project called. Our pupils are engaged in weekly PE Sessions and we also have additional PE Booster sessions.
We provide opportunities for our pupils to make healthy choices e.g. by offering healthy alternatives at snack time.
If you have any concerns about healthy living and your child, please contact your child’s class teacher.
Please also follow this link for more information on the NHS Better Health, healthier families website, full of useful information and handy tips on how to keep healthy.
Tesco has released some great videos to teach children about healthy foods under their ‘Eat Happy Project’. These are great resources to discuss the issue of healthy eating with your child. To access the full range of videos, please click this link: Eat Happy Project. Please see some of the videos below.
